st: Making New Friends: Chibi Moon's Adventure
d: Chibi-Usa has returned from the future to complete her training as a Sailor Guardian. She is to learn how to make friends in the twentieth century.

st: I Want Power: Mako Lost in Doubt
d: After experiencing a humiliating defeat by a Daimon, Makoto decides to retrain herself in the mountains.

st: The Bond of Destiny: Uranus's Distant Past
d: The girls are taking a tour at one of the high schools they plan to apply to next year.

st: Art Is an Explosion of Love: Chibi-Usa's First Love
d: Chibi-Usa is stunned at the sight of Usagi and the others enjoying an apple pie since she actually made the pie especially for Masanori, the boy she has a crush on.
Mamoru and the girls receive an invitation to a party hosted by Edwards, an Englishman who lives alone on the outskirts of the town.

st: The Shocking Moment: Everyone's Identities Revealed
d: Minako realizes that she is the only Sailor Guardian who has not been targeted by a Daimon.

st: The Death of Uranus and Neptune: The Talisman Appears
d: Michiru and Haruka sense that soon they will find the talismans.

st: The Holy Grail's Mystical Power: Moon's Double Transformation
d: Uranus and Neptune are revealed to be the ones possessing the talismans. In order to save the two, the Sailor Guardians go after Eudial, who is on the run with their talismans.

st: Who Is the True Messiah? Chaos of Light and Darkness
d: Mimete takes over for the deceased Eudial to gather the pure hearts necessary to awaken the Messiah of Silence. Mimete sets as her first target Yosaku Eda, a popular actor whom she is also a fan of.

st: A House Filled with Evil Presence: The Beautiful Hotaru's Secret
d: Usagi is very intrigued when she hears Chibi-Usa is going to a “friend's” house to play.
Minako and Mimete enter a movie audition where the winner gets to costar with the idol Jinta Araki. As his longtime fans, both girls are eager to win the role no matter what.

st: Shadow of Silence: The Pale Glimmer of a Firefly
d: The Three Guardians of the Outer Solar System sense something dangerous lurking inside Hotaru Tomoe's personality.

st: Sunny Skies After a Storm: A Friendship Dedicated to Hotaru
d: Hotaru tries to avoid Chibi-Usa out of fear that her other violent personality will someday bring harm to her only friend. Undaunted, Chibi-Usa invites Hotaru to go on a picnic.

st: Higher and Stronger: A Cheer from Usagi
d: Shun Hayase is a high school athlete who sets a new national record in the men's high jump after overcoming health issues as a child.
